name: Ahuzzam
overview: Ahuzzam was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Ashhur and Naarah. His mention in Scripture is brief, focusing primarily on his lineage within the tribe. There are no additional notes or detailed narratives about his life or deeds.
namesAndTitles: The name Ahuzzam means 'possessor,' reflecting a proper name given to him, though not directly attributed as given by God. This meaning may imply a sense of ownership or stewardship, but Scripture records no further significance beyond the name itself.
familyAndRelationships: Ahuzzam is explicitly recorded as the son of Ashhur and Naarah. Scripture does not provide any further family relationships beyond this direct parentage, limiting our knowledge of his broader familial context.
scriptureSignificance: Ahuzzam's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of the tribe of Judah, as noted in 1 Chronicles 4:6. While the biblical text does not elaborate on his personal achievements or role, his mention contributes to the preservation of the lineage and heritage of God's chosen people. This genealogical detail underscores the faithfulness of God's promises through generations within Judah.
